name: Rubik's x Star Wars Cubers 3x3 (Grogu)
description: The Rubik's x Star Wars Cubers 3x3 (Grogu) is a playful and collectible twist on the classic cube. The puzzle itself looks like Grogu’s head, complete with detachable ears for extra charm. It rests on a stand shaped like his robed body in his hovering pram, making it great for both solving and display.
